title: Digital Root
description:
The digital root of a number is obtained by repeatedly summing its digits until you get a single digit. Return the digital root of `n`.

**Example:**
```
digital_root(493) → 7   # 4+9+3=16, 1+6=7
digital_root(942) → 6   # 9+4+2=15, 1+5=6
digital_root(5) → 5
```
hint: While n >= 10, replace n with the sum of its digits. Return n when it's a single digit.
